Concessions at Citizens Theatre

Standard prices run £14–£55 in the Main Theatre and £12.50–£23.50 in the Studio. Four free memberships carry a reduced price; each needs a one-off sign-up, and none asks for ID.

Gorbals Pass£5

Residents with a G5 postcode. Two tickets per household.

Free membership, signed up for once.

Low Income Pass£5

Audience members on a low household income, unemployed, or receiving low-income benefits.

Free membership, signed up for once. No ID required.

Under 30s Pass£10

Ages 16–29, on standard shows. 50% off Christmas and selected productions.

Free membership, signed up for once.

Access Pass50% off full price, plus a free companion ticket

Audience members with additional access needs.

Free membership, signed up for once.

Children£10

Under 16s on standard shows, unless age restrictions apply. 50% off Christmas and selected productions.

Schools£10

School groups, booked through the Box Office.

Fees

£1.50 booking fee per transaction, waived for Theatre Pass members. £1.50 of every full-price ticket is a redevelopment levy, already included in the published price and excluded from the Gorbals, Low Income, Access and Under 30s prices.
